info.cls_ename: Department of Mechanical and Computer-Aided Engineering

description.describe_ch: 著重於智慧製造基礎介紹，了解生產製造之各系統及其整合運用技術的基礎概念，俾能對智慧製造建立初步了解，建立未來應用及研究發展的基礎。透過智慧製造導論引導學生認識智慧製造技術的發展，並熟悉智能化機械、智慧機器人、設備協同生產、智慧工廠、物聯網、大數據分析、虛實整合系統等與智慧機械製造相關的概念。
description.describe_eh: Focus on the basic introduction of smart manufacturing, understand the basic concepts of various manufacturing systems and their integrated application technologies, so as to establish a preliminary understanding of smart manufacturing and establish the basis for future applications and research and development. Through the introduction to smart manufacturing, students are guided to understand the development of smart manufacturing technology, and familiarize themselves with concepts related to smart machine manufacturing, such as intelligent machinery, smart robots, equipment collaborative production, smart factories, Internet of Things, big data analysis, and virtual-real integration systems.

targets.describe_ch: 認識智慧製造的技術需求與應用情境。
targets.describe_en: Understand the technical requirements and application scenarios of smart manufacturing.

targets.describe_ch: 認識智慧製造相關技術的原理與操作。
targets.describe_en: Understand the principles and operations of technologies related to smart manufacturing.

targets.describe_ch: 透過智慧機械廊道場域資源、了解跨領域製造技術，增加學生對智慧製造的認識與興趣。
targets.describe_en: Through the field resources of the smart machinery corridor and understanding of cross-domain manufacturing technology, students will increase their knowledge and interest in smart manufacturing.
